item.description:
### Added - **Antigravity: a session waiting for you to trust its folder now shows up.** The Antigravity CLI asks "Do you trust the contents of this project?" the first time you open it somewhere new, and until you answered, the session was missing from Perch. It now reads "Waiting for you to trust this folder".
### Fixed - **Devin: a session you quit now leaves the list right away,** instead of lingering until Perch noticed the process was gone. Resuming a session you just quit keeps it on the list.
